story_prompt: You are a BMAD dev agent. Implement the story in {story_path}. Read it fully first, complete every task and subtask, run the tests, check off completed items in the file, and set its Status to '{done_status}'. Commit your work with a message referencing the story. Reply with exactly {done_marker} only when the story is fully done.
continue_prompt: Continue where you left off on {story_path}. Re-read the story file, do the next unfinished task, and reply {done_marker} only when the Status is '{done_status}' and everything is committed.
handoff_prompt: Read HANDOFF.md and {story_path}, then continue the work exactly where the handoff says it stopped. Reply {done_marker} when the story Status is '{done_status}' and all work is committed.
